title: Weird mall world dream
content: I have done extensive research on the mall world, have heard countless stories and my ears perked hearing up when I hear about the highway turning into a roller coaster, I have a reoccurring thing that happens in my dreams where a high speed rail train is a rollercoaster , it’s bright neon red I have been to many places described it seems but I never hear anyone talk about a city made of Shacks , and those shacks are as tall as regular real life buildings but their made of sheet metal, old wood, plastic and other cheap materials . Very post apocalyptic. I’ve had several dreams seeing the high speed roller coaster from a city of shacks . There’s always parties but no vegetation just buildings that look like they were built out of recycled and cheap materials . Has anyone else experienced this when going to mall world ?
